address: 520 Trung Nu Vuong Street, Hoa Thuan Tay Ward, Hai Chau District, Da Nang, 550000, Vietnam
bio: As the name suggests, there's only one thing on the menu – cơm gà, or chicken rice, but you can opt for the poultry roasted, steamed or shredded. Served with soup and pickles, the cơm gà xé bóp (shredded version), is especially popular. The lemongrass, coriander and onion lend the juicy chicken extra zing. Given the quality of the food and bargain prices, it's no surprise that this place is always jam-packed. Avoid peak hours....
